# Verdant Sanctum gameplay

**In progress: slices 1-4, the parry and the seeded tuning step merged; the lingering-bramble pressure step in review; slice 5 (the Rootbinder) built on its branch.** The owner rejected the Verdant gameplay a third time on 2026-11-20: the shared Verdant base is slop, move visuals linger after the move, and Verdant leans on tells far more than any other boss. Verdant's boss, enemies and stage are rebuilt from scratch in the pattern of Aldric, the Echo and the Colossus, keeping only the approved Rootbound seed-pod figure and the drawn background. Measured on main 6fb1a7cd: a scripted player takes 2.8, 1.1 and 0 hits per 10 s from today's Rootbound across its three phases, against 4 to 7 from the reference bosses; its Phase III does not move; its two phase cinematics block 12.9 s of a 37 s fight; it draws 16 tell marks against Aldric's 6. The plan adds two rules over every boss and enemy (nothing outlives its move, tell weight) and builds the new Verdant on the engineering channel until the owner approves it on preview.

- Next: The pressure step (#400): every Surface Strike, the Root Seam, the Bramble Rows, the planted vine and Last Bloom's ring leave patches of bramble that stay on the floor (caps 2, 4 and 5 by phase, oldest withers first, on the boss's one zone field). Scripted hits per 10 s are 1.9, 3.5 and 4.4 by phase: Phases II and III are in their bands; Phase I (1.9 against 2.5-4.4) is open for the lead. A seeded test over the twelve seeds proves no patch goes live under the player without its whole tell; the floor always keeps a gap; clears stay in band. The tell-avoiding player walks into standing zones on any boss (a named tool gap). Then slice 5, the new Rootbinder. The plan's 6.1 is the handoff.
